title: High Volume Hell
author: Troy J.
desc: Build a stronger mind and body.  This program is extreme.  It's not designed to increase your 1rm anything.  This is designed to teach your mind you can do way more than it wants you to do.  The result is increased muscle and a mind that will allow you to push through your barriers.  Use a moderate weight, 50-60% of your 1 rm for majority of the lifts.  The goal is to get through the entire workout with max effort on every set.  If you go to heavy that will not happen.
